description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-22. -->
## YouTube

- Dark portrait playback now keeps the buffered-but-unplayed portion of the seekbar visible after the controls fade. No setting is needed. This applies to on-demand video, not live streams ([#71](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/71)).
- In **RVX Settings → Player → Player buttons**, adjust the background opacity of Play/Pause/Replay and Previous/Next separately from the timestamp and other player buttons. Both sliders inherit your old value; neither changes the icons or the player scrim ([#72](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/72)).
- With the **Chip** border preset, the playlist bottom bar now honors **Invert snack bar theme** without changing the bar’s fill ([#65](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/65)).

## YouTube and YouTube Music

- Long RVX setting titles wrap instead of being cut off beside switches ([#65](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/65)).

## Manager

If Manager shows upstream v4.3.0 release notes, use the [stable source URL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/rvx-latest/patches-bundle.json) under **Sources → + → Remote**. When patching experimental YouTube 21.45.90, choose the plain `21.45.90` APK, not `21.45.90-EXTENDED` ([#66](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/66)). Update the patch source, then repatch your app.

**Verification:** 15 focused tests passed. All four supported YouTube versions patched without force or missing extension references. On the Moto, the gray buffered segment advanced with controls hidden. Both opacity settings persisted after restart; both directions were render-tested on the host, and transparent transport with opaque overlays was also observed on the phone.
